newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products all lose ground, except fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products all lose ground, except fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were weaker on Monday, except for steady fuel, traders said.
Gasoline lost $1-2 a tonne on weaker crude and sharply lower NYMEX gasoline prices. Bearish Euroil data also contributed. Naphtha lost about $2 a tonne, trundling behind crude.
Gas oil sagged $7.25 a tonne on easier futures and milder weather. Good demand supported heating oil cargo premiums.
Fuel oil was around steady. High sulphur barges had made early $2 gains on short-covering after Friday's sell-off, Cargoes softened in thin demand and Low sulphur prices were steady in quiet trade.
